mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_factor_snapshot(symbol, source, verified_through, content_hash, raw_json, fetched_at, last_verified_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, COALESCE(#{source}, 'BAOSTOCK'), #{verifiedThrough}, #{contentHash}, #{rawJson}, #{fetchedAt}, #{fetchedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE verified_through=GREATEST(verified_through, VALUES(verified_through)), last_verified_at= VALUES(last_verified_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, trade_date, universe_scope, model_version, content_hash, analysis_json, evidence_json, fetched_at FROM market_observation_snapshot WHERE id=( SELECT id FROM market_observation_snapshot WHERE trade_date<=#{date} AND universe_scope='SH_SZ_A' AND model_version='SH_SZ_OBSERVATION_V1' ORDER BY trade_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO market_observation_snapshot(trade_date, universe_scope, model_version, content_hash, analysis_json, evidence_json, fetched_at) VALUES(#{tradeDate}, COALESCE(#{universeScope},'SH_SZ_A'), COALESCE(#{modelVersion},'SH_SZ_OBSERVATION_V1'), #{contentHash}, #{analysisJson}, #{evidenceJson}, #{fetchedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id,trade_date,universe_scope,model_version,content_hash,analysis_json,evidence_json,fetched_at FROM market_observation_snapshot WHERE id=(SELECT MAX(id) FROM market_observation_snapshot WHERE trade_date=#{date} AND universe_scope='FULL_A' AND model_version='FULL_A_OBSERVATION_V1')

SELECT id,symbol,source,verified_through,content_hash,raw_json,fetched_at,last_verified_at FROM market_factor_snapshot WHERE source=#{source} AND verified_through>=#{end} AND (source='BAOSTOCK' OR STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_json,'$.coverageFrom')),'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{start}) ORDER BY symbol,verified_through DESC,id DESC
